ValidationRule.description: If Employment Status = Employed then Length of Service, STL – S/O Condition, Whitelisted Employer, Employer Name, Employer Sector, Employer Grade, Employer Address are mandatory
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( ISCHANGED(cc_Credit_Pre_Screening_Result__c), ISPICKVAL(cc_Credit_Pre_Screening_Result__c, "Accept"), ISPICKVAL(cc_Employment_Status__c, "Employed"), ($User.LastName <> "Integration"), TEXT(Region_Flag__c) == 'Bahrain', OR( ISPICKVAL(cc_Length_Of_Service__c, ''), ISPICKVAL(STL_S_O_Condition__c, ''), ISBLANK(cc_Employer_Name__c), ISPICKVAL(cc_Employer_Sector__c, ''), ISPICKVAL(cc_Employer_Grade__c, ''), ISBLANK(cc_Credit_Bureau_Score__c), ISPICKVAL(cc_Credit_Bureau_Risk_Rating__c, ''), ISBLANK(cc_Occupation__c), ISBLANK(Listed_Employer_Name__c), ISBLANK(cc_House_Flat_Number__c), ISBLANK(cc_Building__c), ISBLANK(Street_Road_No__c), ISBLANK(cc_Block_No__c), ISBLANK(cc_City__c), ISPICKVAL(cc_Country__c, '') ),
OR( AND( ISPICKVAL(Type, "Credit Card Application"), ISPICKVAL(Sub_Type__c, "New Credit Card") ), ISPICKVAL(Type, "Convert Credit Card Nature Application") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please fill the Length of Service, STL Condition, Employer Name,Sector, Grade,Credit Bureau Score, Risk Rating, Occupation, Listed Employer, Flat Number, Building, Street,Block,City and Country fields.
